'''Sonny''' (Japanese: '''ソノタ''' ''Sonota'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG078|Cruisin' for a Losin']]''. He is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]].

Sonny entered the [[Rank (Contest)|R1]] [[Rubello Town]] [[Pokémon Contest]] with his {{p|Girafarig}}. After advancing through the [[Appeal|Appeals Round]], he faced off against [[Drew]] in the first match of the [[Contest Battle|Battle Round]]. Sonny hoped that he would defeat the Coordinator and take home the Rubello Town [[Ribbon]]. Unfortunately, Drew and his {{p|Masquerain}} proved to be stronger than he had hoped, and Sonny and his Girafarig were defeated.
